takeaways: Rotate into broad market ETFs and consumer staples as bullish momentum supports defensive growth positioning.
Accumulate quality financials and healthcare names on dips while institutional buying builds steady bases.
Reduce semiconductor exposure as distribution signals potential near-term weakness despite tech sector strength.
Avoid AI, robotics, and biotech sectors as bearish sentiment indicates continued downside pressure ahead.
Trim crypto and commodities positions immediately as bearish conditions suggest capital preservation over speculation.

Individual names paint an equally grim picture: NVDA carries a weekly sell, MSFT and AI show monthly sells, while META and SOUN trigger daily exits. The lone bright spot is CFLT with a weekly buy signal, diverging sharply from the pack and warranting close attention for sector rotation plays.

Fundamental crosscurrents offer little clarity. NVIDIA garners headlines for powering France's AI ambitions, yet the stock can't catch a bid domestically. Mark Cuban's broadside urging AI companies to prioritize people over data centers hints at growing political headwinds. Watch NVDA for breakdown confirmation, CFLT for relative strength continuation, and PATH as its weekly sell meets monthly void.
